# Manifest basic page

This file stands in for a canonical repository document with no docs/site
wrapper at all: a route manifest maps it straight to a page, so editing this
file edits the site.

> [!CAUTION]
> **Silent failure** — a control that fails without telling anyone is worse
> than one that fails loudly.

See [the nested note](../nested/deep.md) and the
